answer.reason: The verses tell of Hannah's prayer and vow for a son and of her bringing Samuel to the LORD, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: prayed and vowed to give a son to the LORD, and Eli thought she was drunken
clauses.quote: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.

clauses.english: bore Samuel and brought him to the house of the LORD in Shiloh when he was weaned
clauses.quote: brought him unto the house of the LORD in Shiloh

clauses.english: was visited by the LORD and bore three more sons and two daughters
clauses.quote: bare three sons and two daughters

doubts: Clause 1 joins the prayer with Eli's mistake; the second part may be trimmed as a minor detail.
The 'Hannah prayed' song of 1SA 2:1 was left out as praise rather than an event.
